info.title: Docamatic API
info.description: REST API for generating PDFs and images, writing to PDFs, merging files, encrypting documents, and checking account usage.

post.summary: Generate a PDF from URL or HTML
Generate a PDF or image from a template
Generate an image or screenshot from URL or HTML

post.description: Undocumented alias for the /image endpoint. Accepts the same request body and returns the same response.

post.summary: Write text, images, QR codes, and barcodes to an existing PDF
Merge multiple PDFs into one document

delete.description: Deletes a file from Docamatic storage. All files are also automatically deleted after the configured storage period.

get.summary: Get API usage summary for the current billing period

get.description: Returns profile information for the authenticated user.
Returns a list of documents stored for the authenticated user.

get.summary: List templates available to the user

BearerAuth.description: Pass your Docamatic API key as a Bearer token in the Authorization header.

BadRequest.description: Bad request — the request was invalid

Unauthorized.description: Unauthorized — user does not have permission

MethodNotAllowed.description: Method Not Allowed — incorrect HTTP method provided

RequestTimeout.description: Request Timeout — the request timed out

UnsupportedMediaType.description: Unsupported Media Type — response is not valid JSON

ValidationError.description: Unprocessable Entity — valid JSON but an error was encountered

RateLimited.description: Too Many Requests — client has exceeded 120 requests per minute

InternalServerError.description: Internal Server Error — please try again or contact support

PaperFormat.description: Paper format. Takes priority over width/height when set.

TemplateName.description: A valid Docamatic template name. See https://docamatic.com/templates for previews and example requests.

EmailOptions.description: Options for emailing the generated document.

S3Options.description: Options for saving the generated document directly to your own Amazon S3 bucket. Your bucket policy must grant Docamatic write permissions.

region.description: AWS region where your bucket is located (e.g. us-east-1).

bucket.description: S3 bucket name. Must not be 'docamatic'.

path.description: Optional path prefix within the bucket (e.g. 'invoices').

BasicAuthOptions.description: Credentials for basic HTTP authentication on a protected source URL.

source.description: A valid URL or HTML string to generate the PDF from.

media.description: Generate the PDF using screen or print CSS media rules.

format.description: Paper format. Takes priority over width/height when set.

margin_top.description: Top paper margin. Unit is controlled by margin_unit.

margin_right.description: Right paper margin. Unit is controlled by margin_unit.

margin_bottom.description: Bottom paper margin. Unit is controlled by margin_unit.

margin_left.description: Left paper margin. Unit is controlled by margin_unit.

margin_unit.description: Unit of measurement for margin values.

width.description: Paper width. Ignored if format is set.

height.description: Paper height. Ignored if format is set.

unit.description: Unit of measurement for width and height.

landscape.description: Set to true for landscape orientation.

test.description: Create a test document that does not consume production credits. The document will have a 'sample' watermark.

encode.description: Return the document as a base64 encoded string. Documents over 4MB cannot be returned as base64 — a URL will be returned instead.

webhook.description: A valid URL to receive a POST request with the result once the document has been generated. Your endpoint must return a 200 status code.

zoom.description: Scale of the webpage rendering. Must be between 0.1 and 2.

disable_backgrounds.description: Suppress background graphics in the generated PDF.

delay.description: Delay in milliseconds before capturing the page.

header_template.description: HTML template for the print header. Use CSS classes date, title, url, pageNumber, totalPages to inject dynamic values.

footer_template.description: HTML template for the print footer. Uses the same format as header_template.

header_footer.description: Enable display of header and footer.

page_numbers.description: Insert page numbers into the footer of each page. Ignored if footer_template is set.

css.description: A valid URL pointing to a CSS file or a CSS string to inject before generation. If a URL, it must be publicly accessible.

prefer_css_page_size.description: Give CSS @page size declarations priority over width/height/format options.

page_ranges.description: Page ranges to print, e.g. '1-5, 8, 11-13'. Defaults to all pages.

accept_cookie_warning.description: Attempt to automatically accept cookie consent notifications before generating the document. See click_elements for manual targeting.

click_elements.description: Click button or link elements before generation. Specify elements by CSS class name or text value, e.g. ["Accept", ".cookie-btn"].

name.description: A descriptive name for your document, visible in the dashboard.

template.description: A valid template name. See https://docamatic.com/templates.

data.description: Data to pass to the template. All fields are optional — see individual template pages for example requests.

lines.description: Line items array, commonly used by Zapier integrations.

format.description: Paper format. Ignored if the template has a fixed size.

width.description: Document width. Ignored if format is set or the template has a fixed size.

height.description: Document height. Ignored if format is set or the template has a fixed size.

unit.description: Unit of measurement for width and height.

landscape.description: Set to true for landscape orientation.

test.description: Create a test document that does not consume production credits. The document will have a 'sample' watermark.

encode.description: Return the document as a base64 encoded string. Documents over 4MB cannot be returned as base64 — a URL will be returned instead.

webhook.description: A valid URL to receive a POST request with the result once the document has been generated. Your endpoint must return a 200 status code.

quality.description: A float value between 1 and 3. Higher values produce better quality but larger file sizes.

page_numbers.description: Insert page numbers into the footer of each page. Only applies when generating as a PDF.

name.description: A descriptive name for your document, visible in the dashboard.

font.description: A Google Font name (must match exactly). Browse fonts at https://fonts.google.com. Examples: Lato, Open Sans, Nunito.

font_size.description: Base font size scalar. Valid range is 0.5 to 1.4.

font_color.description: Hex color code for the font color, e.g. #000000.

source.description: A valid URL or HTML string to generate the image from.

media.description: Generate the image using screen or print CSS media rules.

width.description: Image width. Unit is controlled by the unit parameter.

height.description: Image height. Unit is controlled by the unit parameter.

unit.description: Unit of measurement for width and height.

mobile.description: Whether to take the meta viewport tag into account (simulates a mobile device).

landscape.description: Set to true for landscape viewport orientation.

full_page.description: When true, captures the full scrollable page rather than just the visible viewport.

test.description: Create a test image that does not consume production credits. The image will have a 'sample' watermark.

encode.description: Return the image as a base64 encoded string. Images over 4MB cannot be returned as base64 — a URL will be returned instead.

webhook.description: A valid URL to receive a POST request with the result once the image has been generated. Your endpoint must return a 200 status code.

quality.description: A float value between 1 and 3. Higher values produce better quality but larger file sizes.

clip.description: Defines a clipping region of the page to capture.

x.description: X-coordinate of the top-left corner of the clip area.

y.description: Y-coordinate of the top-left corner of the clip area.

css.description: A valid URL pointing to a CSS file or a CSS string to inject before generation. If a URL, it must be publicly accessible.

delay.description: Delay in milliseconds before capturing the page.

accept_cookie_warning.description: Attempt to automatically accept cookie consent notifications before generating the image. See click_elements for manual targeting.

click_elements.description: Click button or link elements before generation. Specify elements by CSS class name or text value, e.g. ["Accept", ".cookie-btn"].

name.description: A descriptive name for your image, visible in the dashboard.

source.description: A URL pointing to an existing PDF, or a base64-encoded PDF string.

encoding.description: Text encoding to use when writing.

text.description: One or more text strings to add to the PDF.

cells.description: One or more text cells that support line breaks and alignment.

images.description: One or more images to add to the PDF.

barcodes.description: One or more barcodes to add to the PDF.

qr_codes.description: One or more QR codes to add to the PDF.

test.description: Create a test document that does not consume production credits. The document will have a 'sample' watermark.

encode.description: Return the document as a base64 encoded string. Documents over 4MB cannot be returned as base64 — a URL will be returned instead.

webhook.description: A valid URL to receive a POST request with the result. Your endpoint must return a 200 status code.

page_numbers.description: Insert page numbers into the footer of each page.

name.description: A descriptive name for your document, visible in the dashboard.

text_value.description: The text string to write to the PDF.

text_color.description: Hex color code for the text, e.g. #cb4335.

font.description: Font family. Supports: Arial, Courier, Helvetica, Times, PassionsConflict, ArchivoBlack. Defaults to Arial.

font_style.description: Font style flags: B (bold), I (italic), U (underline). Combine as needed, e.g. 'BUI'.

text_x.description: X coordinate for the text position in mm.

text_y.description: Y coordinate for the text position in mm.

text_page_number.description: Page number to write the text to. If omitted, text is written to all pages.

width.description: Cell width. Defaults to the right margin of the page.

align.description: Text alignment: L (left), C (center), R (right), J (justified).

text_value.description: The text string to write. Supports line breaks with \n.

text_color.description: Hex color code for the text, e.g. #cb4335.

font.description: Font family. Supports: Arial, Courier, Helvetica, Times, PassionsConflict, ArchivoBlack. Defaults to Arial.

font_style.description: Font style flags: B (bold), I (italic), U (underline). Combine as needed, e.g. 'BUI'.

cell_x.description: X coordinate for the cell position in mm.

cell_y.description: Y coordinate for the cell position in mm.

cell_page_number.description: Page number to add the cell to. If omitted, the cell is added to all pages.

image_url.description: URL of the image to embed in the PDF. Must be publicly accessible.

image_width.description: Width of the image in mm.

image_height.description: Height of the image in mm.

image_x.description: X coordinate for the image position in mm.

image_y.description: Y coordinate for the image position in mm.

image_page_number.description: Page number to add the image to. If omitted, the image is added to all pages.

barcode_value.description: The string value to encode in the barcode, e.g. '901193283'.

barcode_width.description: Width of the barcode in mm.

barcode_height.description: Height of the barcode in mm.

barcode_x.description: X coordinate for the barcode position in mm.

barcode_y.description: Y coordinate for the barcode position in mm.

barcode_page_number.description: Page number to add the barcode to. If omitted, the barcode is added to all pages.

qr_code_value.description: The string value to encode in the QR code, e.g. 'https://google.com'.

qr_code_size.description: Size of the QR code in mm.

qr_code_x.description: X coordinate for the QR code position in mm.

qr_code_y.description: Y coordinate for the QR code position in mm.

qr_code_page_number.description: Page number to add the QR code to. If omitted, the QR code is added to all pages.

items.description: A URL pointing to a PDF or a base64-encoded PDF string.

files.description: An array of PDF URLs or base64 strings to merge. Minimum 2 files required.

test.description: Create a test document that does not consume production credits. The document will have a 'sample' watermark.

encode.description: Return the document as a base64 encoded string. Documents over 4MB cannot be returned as base64 — a URL will be returned instead.

webhook.description: A valid URL to receive a POST request with the result. Your endpoint must return a 200 status code.

name.description: A descriptive name for your document, visible in the dashboard.

source.description: A URL pointing to an existing PDF, or a base64-encoded PDF string.

password.description: The password to set on the PDF. When test is true, the password is always 'docamatic_sample'.

encryption.description: Encryption strength. AES_128 requires Acrobat 7+; AES_256 requires Acrobat X+.

test.description: Create a test document that does not consume production credits. Password will always be 'docamatic_sample'.

webhook.description: A valid URL to receive a POST request with the result. Your endpoint must return a 200 status code.

name.description: A descriptive name for your document, visible in the dashboard.

transaction_id.description: The transaction_id returned when the document was generated.

document.description: A URL to the generated document, or a base64-encoded string if encode was true.

size.description: Human-readable file size of the generated document, e.g. '85.79 KB'.

transaction_id.description: Unique identifier for the transaction. Used to delete the document or locate it in the dashboard.

url.description: URL of the document that was deleted.

CreditsResponse.description: Summary of API usage for the current billing period.

limit.description: Total production credits available in the billing period.
Total test credits available in the billing period.

period_start.description: Start of the current billing period (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS).

period_end.description: End of the current billing period (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS).

message.description: Human-readable summary of the validation failure.
